name: HistoryModule
description: ESPRack module: history — time series on flash without wearing it out. IHistoryProvider (App::history()): series of columns (sum/avg/min/max/last, arrays per cell) with rollup tiers and retention, or put-series of exact records; buffered in RAM (PSRAM when present), written in batches by its own task while PowerGuard allows, served at /api/v1/history/series. History page: storage, writes against a daily budget, wear estimate, series.
